**Policy applied:** Rule 1 (respect), Rule 2 (no hate/harassment), Rule 3 (no mocking of disabilities/mental health/race), Rule 5 (no heated political debates), Rule 6 (no misinformation). Two repeat offenders drive the toxicity: **jake_from_ohio** (10 violations: 1004, 1007, 1012, 1015, 1020, 1024, 1028, 1032, 1038, 1043) and **tyler.bennett** (11 violations: 1003, 1006, 1009, 1013, 1019, 1022, 1026, 1030, 1034, 1047).
